text:
leo (SRE): Quick proposal: pilot a 'closure steward' for postmortem actions. 10-business-day window, each remediation needs owner, due_date, and tiny lifecycle (triage -> fix -> verify). One weekly 30m sync until closed.

maya: ok. what are the absolute-minimal tracker fields? keep it tiny so teams actually use it.

leo (SRE): minimal row: id | owner | steward | svc | bucket | priority (P0/P1/P2) | due_date | status | verify_link | rc_cat | recurrence_flag. Owner + due_date required; steward rotates.

sophie: +1. add an "age_bucket" (0-7,8-14,15-30,30+) so dashboards can trigger policies, and a short impact line (one sentence).

ops-bot: automated: "Reminder: 2 open follow-through actions >7d. Run /followup-list to view."

maya: rotation idea: keep monthly IC, but steward rotates 2 weeks and overlaps IC handoffs. steward handles stale reviews and escalations.

leo (SRE): automation: bot DMs owners at 48h and 7d, marks stale at 14d and assigns reviewer from steward pool, posts weekly age-bucket summary in thread. Stale -> steward escalates after 15 days.

sophie: verification must be light: 1-paragraph note + dashboard link or smoke-test snippet. optional tiny checklist if deploy involved. Teams won't close heavy tasks.

maya: recurrence detection: tag svc+bucket+rc_cat. weekly rollup: GROUP BY svc,bucket in last 30d; if count>1 flag recurrence. If same flag appears twice in 60d, schedule a recurrence RCA.

leo (SRE): pilot plan: run on next two Sev1/Sev2 incidents (IDs: 9012, 9019). Maya will steward and host first weekly sync. Metrics: median time-to-verify, stale_count, recurrence_flags, open-age histogram.

ops-bot: automated: "Label 'closure-steward-pilot' applied to incidents 9012, 9019."

maya: i'll kick off next Monday and keep the one-pager short. if pilot works, repo with tracker CSV + bot scripts + steward rotation doc is next. Keep low-friction.

leo (SRE): thanks all. small ask: bot reminders = DM-only, summary ok in thread.

sophie: +1.

ops-bot: automated: "Note: weekly follow-through sync invite created."
